title: "jaxcmr.components.support_ratio"

{{< include _generated/components-support-ratio/_body.qmd >}}

Kragel et al. (2015, equations 8–10) sum item support before calculating STOP and use proportional choice among the remaining items. Zhang et al. (2023) use a support ratio for STOP and a softmax for item choice. The policies here use a configurable stopping baseline and a floor of `1e-6` on each studied item's contribution to the ratio. [Kragel et al.](https://nealwmorton.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/06/kragetal15.pdf#page=4) · [Zhang et al.](https://qiongzhang.github.io/optimalpolicies.pdf#page=5)
